EEngine PC texture codec build

Basis Universal: https://github.com/BinomialLLC/basis_universal
Revision: 99f52d63aa6799cbdaecfe977111dc5ec3b31d47
Apache-2.0. See BASIS-LICENSE and BASIS-NOTICE. Upstream sources are unmodified.
Compiled modules: encoder/basisu_bc7e_scalar.cpp, basisu_bc15_spmd.cpp,
basisu_resampler.cpp, basisu_resample_filters.cpp, transcoder/basisu_transcoder.cpp
and their upstream headers. These include derived BC7 encoder notices retained
in upstream source; BASIS-NOTICE accompanies this distribution.

KTX-Software: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/KTX-Software
Release: v4.4.2; revision: 4d6fc70eaf62ad0558e63e8d97eb9766118327a6
See KTX-LICENSE and KTX-LICENSES for Apache-2.0 and third-party notices.
The read-only library includes upstream Basis and Zstd dependencies. KTX1,
GL/Vulkan upload, tools and ETC software unpack are disabled. Upstream source
is unmodified; this is not a blanket relicensing of all upstream dependencies.

Local glue: OEngine/tools/texture-codec/{BcCodec.cpp,KtxRead.cpp,CMakeLists.txt}.
Build: node OEngine/tools/build-pc-texture-codec.mjs all
Compiler revision, binary hashes and glue input hashes: source.json.
Basis native reference: BcReference.cpp; same pinned portable core, separate
native compilation. Neither library owns GPU resources or submits commands.
BcMath.h imports std float sqrt/floor for the native MinGW reference, matching
the global overloads expected by the upstream scalar port and Emscripten.
The retained Basis heap is capped at 160 MiB and libktx at 96 MiB
(256 MiB combined per Worker).
No Spark shader/code is included in this distribution.
